add_library(ImGuiWrapper ImGuiWrapper.h ImGuiWrapper.cpp)
set_property(TARGET ImGuiWrapper PROPERTY POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set_target_properties(ImGuiWrapper PROPERTIES FOLDER ThirdParty/ImGui)
